description: This file contains unit tests for an IRC protocol handling module, testing functions such as parsing IRC lines, sanitizing outbound text, validating targets, and splitting long text messages.

methods.name: parseIrcLine
methods.description: Parses a raw IRC line into structured components.

methods.name: parseIrcPrefix
methods.description: Parses the prefix part of an IRC message into nickname, user, and host.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcOutboundText
methods.description: Sanitizes outbound IRC text to prevent command injection.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcTarget
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes IRC target identifiers.

methods.name: splitIrcText
methods.description: Splits long IRC text messages into chunks within a specified size.
